message.content:
Below is a consolidated list of **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that either falls on a weekday (creating a 3‑day weekend) or falls on a weekend and is observed on the following Monday (also creating a 3‑day weekend).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Province(s) / Territory(ies) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|------------------------------|--------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 2 (Monday) | All Canada | Dec 30–Jan 3 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | Ontario, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island | Feb 18–20 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **St. Patrick’s Day** | Mar 17 (Friday) | — | Newfoundland & Labrador | Mar 17–19 (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | All Canada | Apr 7–9 (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | — | All Canada | May 20–22 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 3 (Monday) | All Canada | Jul 1–3 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | All Canada | Sep 2–4 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **BC Day / Heritage Day / Saskatchewan Day / Manitoba Day** | Oct 2 (Monday) | — | British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba | Oct 1–2 (Sun‑Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | All Canada | Oct 7–9 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Nov 13 (Monday) | All Canada | Nov 11–13 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | All Canada | Dec 23–25 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — | All Canada | Dec 24–26 (Sun‑Tue) |

### Notes

* **Provincial holidays**: Some provinces/territories have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Jean‑Baptiste Day in Quebec on June 24 is a Thursday, so it does *not* create a long weekend).  
* **Observed dates**: When a holiday falls on a weekend, the statutory holiday is observed on the following Monday, which is the date that actually creates the long weekend.  
* **Overlap**: Several provinces share the same holiday dates (e.g., Family Day on Feb 20, BC Day/Heritage Day on Oct 2), so the long‑weekend dates apply to all those jurisdictions.

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific details beyond the major holidays listed above, let me know!
